# omxcode

> Write an app once in Mojo and run it natively on Linux (GTK 4), the web, Android, Mac and iPhone, with the heavy data work on the GPU in the same file. Every running app is also a set of MCP tools an AI agent can call, with no per-app work. Public alpha, MIT licence, Mojo 1.1.

Status, measured by the checks in `scripts/check` (see components.md for the full matrix):

- Runs: Linux (GTK 4), web (FastHTML), the agent host (MCP over stdio), Android (views over JNI, the classic controls).
- Builds and signs, not yet run by a check: Mac (AppKit), iPhone (UIKit).
- GPU path: NVIDIA today. Apple and phone GPUs use the CPU path, which runs the same functions.
- Showcase: omxplorer, a data app over a million rows, one Mojo file of about 4,500 lines.

An app is a struct with `update(event)` and `view() -> View`; the platforms draw the view tree with their own native controls. Build with `scripts/build.sh <example> linux|web|mac|ios|android|all`.

The README, reference, architecture, agent host and components in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://abhisheksreesaila.github.io/omxcode/llms-full.txt)

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/abhisheksreesaila/omxcode/main/README.md): what it is, what it feels like, measured numbers, how to try it
- Tutorials: [your first app](https://abhisheksreesaila.github.io/omxcode/start.html) (a counter: install, build, run, Liquid, an agent) and [a todo app](https://abhisheksreesaila.github.io/omxcode/tasks.html) (`examples/tasks`: a list from data, messages that carry an id, SQLite, test mode, an agent), [add your own model](https://abhisheksreesaila.github.io/omxcode/models.html) (`scripts/setup` from a fresh clone, then `scripts/packs/from_torch.py`: a PyTorch image network converted to a MAX pack, checked against torch, found by its `model.json` and called from a script as a function), and [the slides](https://abhisheksreesaila.github.io/omxcode/learn/) (reveal.js: start → build → what's new); their code blocks are the files' text, checked by `scripts/tutorials.py`
- [Reference](https://abhisheksreesaila.github.io/omxcode/reference.md): the app model, every component, layout, the GPU canvas, the examples
- [How it works](https://abhisheksreesaila.github.io/omxcode/architecture.md): the view tree, the update loop, how each platform is reached
- [The agent host](https://abhisheksreesaila.github.io/omxcode/agent.md): the MCP tools (screen, act, read, render), what an agent gets back, what it can't do yet
- Drawing: `mojoui.ink` (Stroke: points + pressures → one outline polygon; width from speed without pressure; `hits()` for an eraser), `Painter.polygon` and `Painter.layer_transform` (pan/zoom moves a kept layer), `Event.pressure`; example `examples/sketch`
- Audio on the web host (goal 72 M5, docs/web-audio.md): `Microphone` and `Speaker` need no change in the browser: one WebSocket `/audio` carries the page's microphone in and the app's speaker out (tag byte 1/2, 3 kept for the camera), the first tap turns sound on; another device reaches the host only with the pairing key (`mojoui/hosts/pairing.py`: Host allowlist `$MOJOUI_EXTRA_HOSTS`, Origin, key cookie), `scripts/tablet.sh <app>` serves it on the tailnet (`tailscale serve`); example `examples/echo`, check tests/test_web_audio.py
- A local assistant's features (goal 72 M6, D-7260…D-7275): `mojoui.todo` (a to-do file, four agent tools, a card of tick boxes), `mojoui.news` (Google News RSS to headlines and a card of links; https needs `flare` in the app's needs file), `mojoui.llmjob` (think it through on the model's second sequence: a clock, then the answer), `mojoui.cloudlane` (the cloud only when named, `claude -p` as a child process, capped, a ledger of what left), glued by `mojoui.assistant.Assistant` (`LlmAgent.add_deferred`: tools the app answers later); `mojoui.trust` (text from notes or news is fenced data: after it, in the same turn, `LlmAgent.trust` refuses what reaches out or changes things until the person says yes), `mojoui.cloudlane.CloudTurn` (the cloud turn as a state machine, the record written before anything leaves), and a conversation that never fills (`LlmAgent.maintain()` condenses the older turns on the model's second sequence between turns and warms the cache; `start_over()`); example `examples/omx`, check docs/goals/72-check.py M6
- She points and shows (goal 77 M1, M2, M5, D-7701…D-7714): `mojoui.pointer` (a card names its parts: a view tag `card + "." + part` and `Part(card, part, names, cue, weak)`; `match_clause` finds the parts a spoken clause names and how far in; `VoiceLoop.parts` + `POINT` events: the AG-UI CUSTOM `point` {card, part, at_ms} when that audio plays, on the speaker's play clock (`Speaker.next_start_ns`); `Pointer` + `PointerView` draw a soft ring and tint on a clear canvas over the page, springs, following the part (`mojoui.geometry.rect_of`: GTK, and the web host from the rects the page reports); `Orb.look` turns the orb's eyes to it), `mojoui.wordcard` (the catalog's `WordCard`: word typed in, sounds, meaning, example, origin; parts word/sounds/meaning/example/origin), `mojoui.visual` (`VISUAL_SYSTEM`: show first, then one or two sentences naming the card's parts; `Visual.register` stubs `show_map` and `explain` for the map and diagram cards still to come; `card_kind`); example `examples/omx`, check docs/goals/77-check.py, web proof scripts/omx_point_web.py
- The machine: `mojoui.audio` (Microphone: 16 kHz mono from the sound server on its own thread, a ring read by sample index, `level()`, `captured_ns()`; `load_wav`, `best_match`; Linux, Mac builds with a stub) and `mojoui.speech` (SpeechModel: whisper-large-v3-turbo on the GPU in the app's own process through Python interop, samples by address; SpeechStream: `feed()` / `poll()` → PARTIAL words and a FINAL at a pause; run on the `speech` pixi environment, needs file `speech`); example `examples/dictate`, race vs transformers.js in docs/goals/43
- The creator (goal 72 M6, docs/decisions.md D-7280..D-7289): `mojoui.creator.Creator` gives an agent three tools, `make_comic` (the model's plan as a tool call: `mojoui.comic.ComicPlan`, one hero and one seed in every panel), `draw_picture` and `find_in_notes` (`mojoui.notes.NotesIndex`: e5-small by MAX in the process, a cached index, one folder only), and everything behind them: `mojoui.imagegen.ImageServer` (stable-diffusion.cpp's sd-server as a supervised child on its own GPU; a drawing is an HTTP request effect), cards that fill in panel by panel, `Album.hold` (a picture made at run time under a name made safe), `llmagent.T_CALL` (a tool the app answers itself, now or later); example `examples/omx`, check `docs/goals/72-check.py M6`
- Data: `mojoui.sqlite` (Database(path): prepare/bind/step/run, begin/commit/rollback, SQLite's error messages, FTS5; `fts_prefix_query(typed)` for search as you type; the system's libsqlite3 loaded at run time), `FileSaver(title, on_save, suggested=)` (save dialog / download; the app writes the path it's given), `DropTarget(view, on_drop, on_file=)` (files from the file manager, one event per path), `App.closing()` (save what's pending before the app ends); slow work in a job (`mojoui.jobs.start_ui_job`); example `examples/jot`
- Works when closed: `mojoui.watch` (`FolderWatcher(path, wake=True)`: `start()`, `ready()`, `take()` → WatchEvent kind CREATED/MODIFIED/RENAMED/DELETED/OVERFLOW, path, old_path, at_ns; inotify on its own thread, new folders followed, one event per change; `walk_files(root, suffixes)`, `file_stamp(path)`), `App.background()` (True: closing the window hides it, the app keeps running) and `App.window_shown(shown)`, `App.one_instance()` (static: a name; a second launch opens the running one's window and exits before building anything; GTK), a tray item the host publishes for it (`mojoui.tray`, StatusNotifierItem; Activate opens the window), `mojoui.notify.notify(app, title, body)` (org.freedesktop.Notifications); example `examples/keeper`
- [Components × platforms](https://abhisheksreesaila.github.io/omxcode/components.md): what exists where, generated from the code
- [The UI thread](https://abhisheksreesaila.github.io/omxcode/ui-threads.md): why apps don't hang, and the five rules an app (or an agent writing one) follows: slow work is a request, a timer or a job
